SELECT t.id, t.title, t.category, t.trainer, t.start_date, t.end_date, t.hours, t.location, t.cost, t.status, t.create_by, t.create_time, t.update_time, COALESCE(r.trainee_count, 0) AS trainee_count, COALESCE(r.attended_count, 0) AS attended_count, COALESCE(r.passed_count, 0) AS passed_count FROM hr_training t LEFT JOIN (SELECT training_id, COUNT(*) AS trainee_count, SUM(CASE WHEN attended = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS attended_count, SUM(CASE WHEN passed = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS passed_count FROM hr_training_record GROUP BY training_id) r ON r.training_id = t.id
(t.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR t.trainer LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND t.category = #{category} AND t.status = #{status} AND t.start_date BETWEEN #{yearStart} AND #{yearEnd}
ORDER BY t.start_date DESC, t.id DESC
